headline: Apple Reports Record Q2 Earnings
summary: Apple Inc. reported record quarterly earnings of $2.40 per share, beating analyst estimates.

headline: Apple Q2 Earnings: Revenue Beats, Services Growth Accelerates
summary: Apple delivered a strong Q2 with revenue of $94.8B, driven by 14% services growth.

headline: Apple announces new share buyback program
summary: Apple authorized an additional $90 billion share buyback.
